description: Plain-language synthetic requirements with regulatory references.

records.title: Evacuation strategy for the residential floor
records.statement: An evacuation strategy appropriate to residential sleeping occupancy is defined for Level 3 and reconciled with the strategy for the rest of the building.
records.regulatory_reference: Building Regulations 2010, Schedule 1, Part B, requirement B1 (means of warning and escape)
records.statement_origin: Plain-language synthetic requirement authored for the demonstrator; not quoted from any standard.

records.title: Single stair capacity and protection
records.statement: The single common stair provides adequate capacity and protection for the evacuating population under the building's evacuation strategy.
records.regulatory_reference: Building Regulations 2010, Schedule 1, Part B, requirement B1 (means of warning and escape)
records.statement_origin: Plain-language synthetic requirement authored for the demonstrator; not quoted from any standard.

records.title: Protected escape from flats to the common stair
records.statement: Escape from each flat is through protected common circulation separated from the stair.
records.regulatory_reference: Building Regulations 2010, Schedule 1, Part B, requirement B1 (means of warning and escape)
records.statement_origin: Plain-language synthetic requirement authored for the demonstrator; not quoted from any standard.

records.title: Fire detection and alarm within each flat
records.statement: Each flat has automatic fire detection and alarm to a grade and category selected for the residential occupancy.
records.regulatory_reference: Building Regulations 2010, Schedule 1, Part B, requirement B1 (means of warning and escape)
records.statement_origin: Plain-language synthetic requirement authored for the demonstrator; not quoted from any standard.

records.title: Alarm cause-and-effect compatible with the evacuation strategy
records.statement: The building fire alarm cause-and-effect is compatible with the evacuation strategy for the building's occupancies.
records.regulatory_reference: Building Regulations 2010, Schedule 1, Part B, requirement B1 (means of warning and escape)
records.statement_origin: Plain-language synthetic requirement authored for the demonstrator; not quoted from any standard.

records.title: Compartmentation of each flat
records.statement: Each flat forms a separate fire compartment from other flats and from the common parts.
records.regulatory_reference: Building Regulations 2010, Schedule 1, Part B, requirement B3 (internal fire spread - structure)
records.statement_origin: Plain-language synthetic requirement authored for the demonstrator; not quoted from any standard.

records.title: Fire resistance of the Level 3 compartment floor
records.statement: The Level 3 compartment floor and its supporting structure achieve the fire resistance required for the building as altered.
records.regulatory_reference: Building Regulations 2010, Schedule 1, Part B, requirement B3 (internal fire spread - structure)
records.statement_origin: Plain-language synthetic requirement authored for the demonstrator; not quoted from any standard.

records.title: Sprinkler protection to the residential floor
records.statement: The need for, and extent of, automatic sprinkler protection to the residential floor is determined and justified.
records.regulatory_reference: Building Regulations 2010, Schedule 1, Part B, requirement B3 (internal fire spread - structure)
records.statement_origin: Plain-language synthetic requirement authored for the demonstrator; not quoted from any standard.
records.applicability_note: Whether sprinkler protection must be extended to Level 3 depends on the height of the topmost storey and on the evacuation strategy adopted; neither is recorded in the available evidence.

records.title: Fire service access and facilities serving Level 3
records.statement: Fire service access, firefighting facilities and the fire main remain adequate for firefighting on Level 3.
records.regulatory_reference: Building Regulations 2010, Schedule 1, Part B, requirement B5 (access and facilities for the fire service)
records.statement_origin: Plain-language synthetic requirement authored for the demonstrator; not quoted from any standard.

records.title: Regulatory route and higher-risk building status
records.statement: The regulatory route for the works is determined, including whether the building as altered falls within the higher-risk building definition.
records.regulatory_reference: Building Safety Act 2022 (higher-risk building definition); Building Regulations 2010 (material change of use)
records.statement_origin: Plain-language synthetic requirement authored for the demonstrator; not quoted from any standard.
records.applicability_note: Depends on the building's height and storey count measured as the applicable regulations define, and on the number of residential units after the change; the height is not recorded in the available evidence.
